# Data Retention Policy

This policy defines how long each class of data is kept.

## Audit logs

Audit logs are retained for 400 days and then deleted automatically. Security can place a legal hold that suspends deletion for specific accounts.

## Customer uploads

Files uploaded by customers are kept for 90 days after the customer deletes them, so that accidental deletions can be recovered through support.

## Backups

Database backups are encrypted with AES-256 and stored in the eu-north region. Backups are kept for 35 days. Restores are tested every quarter by the platform team.
